moments.title: Premier League & EFL Kick Off
moments.blurb: The new Premier League and EFL Championship seasons are underway this weekend, with fans across the UK buzzing for the return of top-flight football.

angles.name: Saturday Football Buzz
angles.copy: It's Saturday, which means the Premier League and Championship are back! Who are you backing for glory this season?

angles.name: Early Season Predictions
angles.copy: The new football season is officially here! Early predictions: who's making a surprise run, and who's facing an uphill battle?

moments.title: All Points East Festival Begins
moments.blurb: London's Victoria Park will host All Points East festival from August 21st, featuring major headliners like Lorde, Deftones, and Tyler, The Creator across two weekends.

angles.name: London Festival Vibes
angles.copy: All Points East kicks off next Friday in Victoria Park! Who are you most excited to see? Lorde, Deftones, Tyler, The Creator... the line-up is huge!

angles.name: Festival Line-up Hype
angles.copy: Next week, London lights up for All Points East! Get ready for sets from Lorde, Twenty One Pilots, Jorja Smith and more. Your festival soundtrack starts now.

moments.title: Joe Jonas turns 37
moments.blurb: Joe Jonas, singer from the Jonas Brothers and DNCE, celebrates his 37th birthday today, August 15th.

angles.name: Pop Star Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 37th Birthday to Joe Jonas! From Jonas Brothers to DNCE, he's given us so many bops. What's your favourite Joe track?

angles.name: Throwback Jonas
angles.copy: Remember when the Jonas Brothers ruled the world? Today, Joe Jonas turns 37! Relive the early hits.

moments.title: Madonna turns 68
moments.blurb: The Queen of Pop, Madonna, will celebrate her 68th birthday tomorrow, August 16th.

angles.name: Queen of Pop Celebration
angles.copy: Tomorrow, the one and only Madonna turns 68! Celebrate the iconic hits that shaped generations of pop music.

angles.name: Madonna Through the Decades
angles.copy: Get ready to celebrate Madonna's 68th birthday tomorrow! Which era of the Queen of Pop is your absolute favourite?

moments.title: Robert Plant turns 78
moments.blurb: Led Zeppelin frontman Robert Plant will celebrate his 78th birthday on August 20th.

angles.name: Rock Legend Birthday
angles.copy: A huge voice in rock history! Robert Plant of Led Zeppelin turns 78 on August 20th. What's your ultimate Zeppelin track?

angles.name: Classic Rock Icon
angles.copy: Get ready to wish Robert Plant a happy 78th on Thursday! The voice of Led Zeppelin, still an icon.

moments.title: Dua Lipa turns 31
moments.blurb: Global pop superstar Dua Lipa will celebrate her 31st birthday on August 22nd.

angles.name: Pop Queen Celebration
angles.copy: Future Nostalgia Queen! Dua Lipa turns 31 on Sunday. What's your go-to track from her incredible catalogue?

angles.name: Birthday Dance Party
angles.copy: Get ready to dance! Dua Lipa celebrates her 31st birthday this Sunday. We're spinning all her biggest hits to mark the occasion.

moments.title: Roland Orzabal turns 65
moments.blurb: Roland Orzabal, co-founder and lead singer of the iconic 80s band Tears for Fears, celebrates his 65th birthday on August 22nd.

angles.name: 80s Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Shout out to Roland Orzabal of Tears for Fears, who turns 65 this Sunday! What's your favourite track from the legendary duo?

angles.name: Classic Hitmaker
angles.copy: Happy 65th to Roland Orzabal from Tears for Fears this weekend! Relive the timeless sounds of 'Everybody Wants To Rule The World' and more.

moments.title: Shaun Ryder turns 64
moments.blurb: Happy Mondays and Black Grape frontman Shaun Ryder will celebrate his 64th birthday on August 23rd.

angles.name: Madchester Legend
angles.copy: Step On! Shaun Ryder, the legendary voice of Happy Mondays, turns 64 this Monday. What's your favourite track from the Madchester icon?

angles.name: 90s Indie Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 64th Birthday to Shaun Ryder on Monday! Still bringing the vibes from Happy Mondays to Black Grape.

moments.title: Jean-Michel Jarre turns 78
moments.blurb: Pioneering French electronic music composer Jean-Michel Jarre will celebrate his 78th birthday on August 24th.

angles.name: Electronic Pioneer
angles.copy: Happy 78th Birthday to the legendary Jean-Michel Jarre on Tuesday! His influence on electronic music is immeasurable. What's your favourite cosmic journey of his?

angles.name: Ambient Maestro
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 78th birthday to Jean-Michel Jarre this Tuesday! A true master of ambient and electronic soundscapes.

moments.title: Summer Bank Holiday Approaching
moments.blurb: The Summer Bank Holiday for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland is just over two weeks away, falling on Monday, August 31st, marking the unofficial end of summer.

angles.name: Bank Holiday Excitement
angles.copy: Only two weeks until the Summer Bank Holiday on August 31st! Who's planning a last-minute summer getaway or a big BBQ?

angles.name: End of Summer Plans
angles.copy: The countdown to the Summer Bank Holiday is on! How are you making the most of the final long weekend of summer?
